description: Grunt configuration file for build automation, including tasks for minification, linting, testing, and packaging of a Bootstrap datetimepicker project.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Default task running jshint, jscs, less, env:paris, connect, jasmine

methods.name: build:travis
methods.description: Build task for Travis CI including code style, build, and tests

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build task including jshint, jscs, uglify, and less

methods.name: test
methods.description: Test task including jshint, jscs, uglify, less, env:paris, connect, jasmine

methods.name: release
methods.description: Release task that bumps version, builds, documents, and packages
